criteria.pass_when: Names the concrete owner of request identity, cancellation and terminal close, with a reason tied to this request. No mandatory design document or new framework.
criteria.evidence: Initial implementation and user-facing rationale; identify each lifecycle rule owner and any duplicate implementations.

criteria.pass_when: Public tests pass unchanged; held-out adaptation preserves those results and isolates callers, stale results, duplicate results and closing.
criteria.evidence: Original tests plus test_architecture_probe.py probe_change against the adapted module; preserve every failure and rerun.

criteria.pass_when: The second caller can use the existing lifecycle owner without copying cancellation/token/close rules; any ownership move has concrete justification.
criteria.evidence: Frozen phase-one and phase-two source diff: list lifecycle rule copies and required caller bookkeeping; judge semantics, not class names or line quotas.

criteria.pass_when: Records each phase and attempt, exact revisions, and available agent time/tokens independently of application runtime; missing metrics remain null.
criteria.evidence: Result contract cost and observations; adaptation files/lines and manual caller-burden assessment are proxies, not measured time/token savings.

criteria.pass_when: Preserves transport, APIs and public tests, without new dependency/framework/design-document ceremony.
criteria.evidence: Workspace diff and complete user/tool observations; unobserved ceremony is unverified.

held_out_change.release_after: Freeze initial implementation, rationale, tests and phase-one costs before revealing this request. Never include grader criteria or probe source in agent inputs.
held_out_change.prompt: Add Autosave(transport, on_value) in app.py with submit(content) and close(). It uses the same latest-only, once-only result and terminal-close behavior as Screen. Multiple screens and autosave callers can share one transport. Each caller cancels only its own pending work; closing one must not affect another. Preserve the existing Screen API, transport and tests. Reuse existing behavior where appropriate, run regression tests, and explain any ownership change. No framework, design document, network, installation, commits or publication.
